summary: Ouster, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 3,621,876 common shares at $55.22 per share, with an over-allotment option for up to 543,281 additional shares. Northland Securities acted as sole underwriter. The offering was conducted under an existing shelf registration statement on Form S-3. Net proceeds were approximately $191.9 million after underwriting discounts. Directors and executive officers agreed to a 60-day lock-up. This filing describes a routine equity capital raise, not a control transaction, special distribution, or structural change. Accordingly, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situations category.
